scope: Native C200 production menu/frame/font/SDK paths, observed by pausing immediately before first content draw and reading physical LCD, then resuming to capture completed dialogs. Eight dialogs cover command group, domestic, diplomacy, military, character/item tables, numeric amount and city details. Exact pre-fix BDA independently reproduces the early rectangle; completed command-group pixels remain byte-identical. Dedicated synthetic NAND, exact BDA/LIB/CLR RAM staging, no production memory or SDK substitution. Observation fixture is excluded from delivery. Boundary sampling is not a vsync, physical-device latency, full campaign or native filesystem claim.
